name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd.
business_summary: State-owned (81.2%) Mumbai shipyard building warships and submarines (Kolkata-class destroyers, Nilgiri-class P17A frigates, Scorpene submarines, P75 Kalvari), plus submarine refit and offshore work. FY26 sales Rs 13,006 cr, OPM 17%, PAT Rs 2,578 cr. The Sep-2026 quarter was weak: sales Rs 2,446 cr (-16.5% YoY), OP Rs 199 cr (8% margin), PAT Rs 344-346 cr (-54%) on higher provisions (Kotak Neo). Growth hinges on the Project 75I submarine contract (~Rs 90,000 cr with a German partner, unsigned as far as retrieved sources show) and three more Kalvari-class boats.

exposures.mechanism: Order book is thin relative to FY27 target (reported figures conflict: Rs 16,443 cr per unverified aggregator at 30-Sep-2026 vs Rs 27,415 cr per a DSIJ headline; management aims for Rs 1 lakh cr in FY27 only if P75I and Kalvari follow-ons are signed). +10% domestic naval/submarine orders raises inflow expectations by ~10% of ~Rs 1 lakh cr pipeline = Rs 10,000 cr = ~13% of mcap in revenue PV terms at ~12% margin x 70% share -> ~+6 after probability haircut.

evidence.note: P75I described as moving to imminent finalisation; not confirmed signed

exposures.mechanism: Naval capex is part of defence capital outlay; +10% -> +3% pipeline value -> ~+2.5.
Naval and submarine urgency headline effect; fades quickly; persistence 0.25 on a ~12% sentiment move.

Raises global naval spending/escort demand; marginal for MDL's MoD order stream. Pack Brent +1.46 (t=1.7) and refining margin +2.10 (t=2.6) are high-beta defence/risk co-movements (beta 1.78), not cost channels; weight shrunk.
Export frigate/destroyer/offshore interest (Southeast Asia, Gulf, Philippines-type deals) ~0 of revenue today; option value only.

Steel and plates ~10% of costs (model estimate); long-term contracts have price-variation clauses for part; +7% -> costs +0.7% -> at 8-16% OPM EBITDA -4% to -9%; 50% recovered; persistence 0.3 -> ~-0.6.

Imported systems and kits (submarine technology, engines, weapons) ~25% of costs; contracts partly protected. +3% -> unrecovered cost +0.3% of revenue vs OPM 8% (Q2) -> EBITDA -4%; persistence 0.5; EV/MCap 0.85 -> ~-1. Pack -2.78 (t=-1.1) same sign.
Net cash but working capital-heavy with Rs 28,181 cr contingent liabilities; valuation duration at P/E 30. +25 bp -> ~-1.2.
FIIs hold only 1.7%; sentiment channel via PSU-defence basket liquidity; small.

Cochin Shipyard, GRSE, L&T and private yards compete for frigate, submarine and auxiliary orders; one major program lost (e.g. P17B or follow-on submarines) removes ~Rs 30-40k cr of pipeline = ~15% of MDL EV x 40% probability -> ~-5.
